what: REPAIR variant (addendum, post-hoc, labelled) local probe; merged with the core probe

command: systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUQuota=100% -p TasksMax=128 -p MemoryMax=2G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p RuntimeMaxSec=180 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python -I vlm_diag.py OUT --repair; then vlm_diag.py merge merged.json CORE_OUT OUT
host: shared 8-vCPU host, load average 5.0-7.6 at start
